notes.title: 2023 Review / 2024 Preview
notes.content:
Looking Back At 2023

Earlier in the year, our demo for The BridgeMaster was released on Steam, coinciding with its feature in the Steam Puzzle Fest! This got a lot more eyes on the game and produced more of your valuable feedback (more on that below).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/f0aecc811dd22e53531612c0aeb41865bf662a89.jpg

Then we were pleasantly surprised and very honored to be selected for the Seattle Indies Expo! We were among 25 games in the showcase, chosen from more than 50 that applied, so we feel very grateful indeed. Be sure to check out SIX's other games too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/066f7e3a52c1ed63f21ecbee2e0c71da168ff631.png

About a month later, we were back for the SIX Online portion of the expo to share the game in an interview on Twitch! ICYMI, here's the video:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/fd421515e59eb068be144ab19b2ec419481fdd2d.png
(click to view at the timestamp where our segment begins)

The builds for both of these events were preceded by plenty of playtesting and polishing. We made many enhancements, including:


 Adding the much requested option to "Undo" per action
 Adding the scroll collectibles advancing the plot
 Expanding the intro to help establish the premise
 Introducing tutorial prompts to help onboard new players
 Lots of improvements with VFX, SFX, and bug-fixing

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/c2f2a06fd6b21fe00b4c9880bc7cf784bca17f37.png

Check out our previous posts to see more details on these events and all the various changes.

Looking Ahead To 2024

With all that's occurred in 2023, we feel set up for success in 2024! 🎉

Now that we've got a reasonably polished demo as a "vertical slice" of the game, we're building a "horizontal slice" that spans the full game's breadth of content. Once complete, we can avoid the risks of otherwise premature polish efforts being invalidated by major content iteration. That looks like so:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/bd318f7961b5a905ff6eb202cff3586c38911f2b.gif

In the near term, this means we're primarily prototyping our next puzzle mechanics. We'll then utilize these to design, test, and iterate on the remainder of the level progression. We've already made some headway on that effort, which you can see a sneak peek of here:

[previewyoutube=E98OR9Fhkoc;full][/previewyoutube]

Before long, we'll have several new levels utilizing these mechanics and more. Remember I mentioned your valuable feedback? Later in 2024, we will be seeking folks for playtesting to help us make a greater game. If you'd like to contribute, be sure to follow us both here and on Twitter (@CrimsonStoneDev) to find out how you can join us when the time comes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/ab2bd22f3e128ebb747ddaf8cb7bd4bef2c7f584.png

Thanks for all your support so far, and we're excited for all that we have planned in 2024!

notes.title: Selected for the SIX Expo!
notes.content:
SIX 2023

We are very thrilled to share that we’ve been selected for the 2023 lineup of the Seattle Indies Expo! This weekend, we’ll be exhibiting The BridgeMaster at the Motif in Seattle for this free event on Sunday, September 3rd, from noon to 9pm. It’s just a short walk from the Seattle Convention Center if you happen to be there for PAX. We’d love to see you there!

We’re definitely feeling very grateful to be selected! This year, 57 games applied to be part of the showcase, and after 300+ reviews conducted by the panel of jurors, less than half (25) were ultimately selected to be part of the official SIX lineup. We feel very much in good company with an impressive variety of unique indie games, all made here in the Pacific Northwest. We encourage you to check out the other games in the lineup as well!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/066f7e3a52c1ed63f21ecbee2e0c71da168ff631.png

Recent Demo Updates

To prepare for our SIX submission, we made many updates to the demo after the Steam Puzzle Fest. Throughout the process, we conducted playtests regularly to keep a close eye on what was working and what was not. There’s always more room for improvement of course, but we’re confident in saying that the game is now in its best state so far!

Here are many of the changes we’ve made recently:

Design

 Expand intro with new illustrated story panels
 Add to, clarify, and rearrange dialogue
 Remove input suppression with bridge tremble
 Implement support for continuous keyboard input
 Raise star thresholds to reward perfect play
 Update villager AI to walk instead of jump if possible
 Make villager spawns static per level

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/c2f2a06fd6b21fe00b4c9880bc7cf784bca17f37.png

Visuals

 Add VFX for rickety bridge tremble
 Update jump rune icon for legibility
 Display yellow pips for jump segments of escape paths
 Add environmental props to title screen and Worlds 2 & 3
 Include adjacent props when destroying houses

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/f92d8d7cd538b20f0a90e6190d4f43f65257c01a.png

UI / UX

 Add Level Select menu to in-game HUD
 Lerp wood icons to resource counter
 Disable Undo & Restart when moves = 0
 Add pagination buttons and X/Y counter to hints
 Clear FTUE prompts upon activating hint
 Lerp text scale on updates to move and hint counts

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/afc4d5a8237e8a453a3422c769378cb21edd0a13.png

First Time User Experience (FTUE)

 Add to and improve hints for all levels
 Hide hints after the magician moves
 Add FTUE prompt about how villagers escape in Level 2
 Add FTUE prompts for (de)construction in Level 3
 Add FTUE prompt for Undo/Restart in Levels 4 & 5
 Add FTUE prompt for jump runes in Level 10
 Add FTUE prompt for rickety bridge in Level 16
 Clear FTUE prompt for Undo/Restart once either is used

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/52bc5ded1a88ccd2e936bc532422cdf1e561eb6e.png

Music & SFX

 Replace ground rumble and add tile collapse SFX for intro
 Update footsteps SFX per character and surface type
 Add SFX for scroll pickup, rickety bridge, undo, and tile debris
 Add pencil scribble SFX for scroll dialogue and hints
 Play SFX at reduced volume in title screen
 Lerp in/out of paused low pass filter on music

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/a3db30168cca82f338dd16b89f515129e40b7ca9.png

Optimization & Bugfixes

 Limit frame rate to monitor refresh rate
 Self-destruct dust and splinter VFX
 Bugfixes for rickety bridges after undo
 Bugfixes for duplicated actions
 Bugfix for Level Summary scrim
 Bugfix for lerping wood icons

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/f39635a88b514417562b315565909361e78fb9c0.png

As always, thanks for playing, and stay tuned for more to come!

notes.title: Summer '23 Devlog
notes.content:
Hello friends & followers!

This past month, we’ve had more happening with The BridgeMaster than we’ve had in a while! The game came out with an updated demo featured in the Steam Puzzle Fest, which got many new eyes on the game. And since then, we’ve made further updates to the demo, which you can now experience in the latest version today! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/f0aecc811dd22e53531612c0aeb41865bf662a89.jpg

Here are some of the changes we’ve made recently:

Design

 Added the much requested “Undo” per action option!
 Added scroll collectibles to some levels with dialogue advancing the plot
 Updated dialogue for Intro sequence to clarify premise
 Display differing villager responses depending on game state in levels 2 & 4
 Added FTUE prompts for using the “Undo” “Restart” and “Hint” options
 Raised the 3-star thresholds to reward strictly perfect solutions

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/3fa60d7f4269ffb0e2e2a1437ca2a636e3e24116.png

Visuals

 Show land tiles collapsing during the Intro sequence
 Replaced jump tile rune with omni-directional icon for clarity
 Updated meshes for tile nodes to appear more naturally shaped
 Pause time scale while using the “Home” menu
 Added VFX of debris periodically falling from tiles
 Added VFX of dust cloud and planks falling from rickety bridges
 Added VFX of magic sparkles over jump rune tiles
 Improved VFX for house deconstruction effect

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/9ca0d1034a7846a404a5cc4f5a0f3f178679e456.png

Audio

 Added SFX for ground rumble during Intro
 Added SFX for footsteps for magician and villagers
 Added SFX for puzzle solved on level completion
 Added SFX for UI button interactions

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/5717152192d13dbb68c09d8e3044eb336e48f408.png

Bugfixes

 Fixed a scaling issue for logo text in 4K resolutions
 Fixed position of some UI elements for non-16:9 aspect ratios
 Fixed sliding / frozen animations for villagers escaping

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40032706/ab2bd22f3e128ebb747ddaf8cb7bd4bef2c7f584.png

As always, thanks for playing, and stay tuned for more to come!
